title: Identify Test Issues Result
description: Return of the identify-test-issues agent when its prompt gives paths: the pb key it was given, any open ambiguity, and the quality issues it found in the test code of the cycle. The refactor agent fixes them, and an empty list skips the fix

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

ambiguity.description: An open question a human should settle, or an empty string

file.description: File path where issue was found
